message.content:
An editorial magazine cover features an illustration of a man with dark hair, light skin, and a wide-open mouth, positioned centrally against a light-yellow background with a red vertical border on the left. He wears tan, short-sleeved collared clothing, a brown belt, and a dark brown bracer on his left forearm. He is crouched, holding a wooden bow in his left hand and a single arrow in his right, pointed downward. Several other arrows fly through the air behind him, one of which has knocked a tan, feathered cap off his head.

The text "TEMPO" appears in large, semi-transparent white letters behind him. Other transcribed text includes "SENJAKALA KEWENANGAN JAKSA," "DAGELAN POLITIK PARTAI GOLKAR," "AMUK REKLAMASI," and "KPK membidik Ahok dalam perkara pungutan penimbunan Teluk Jakarta. Korupsi atau maladministrasi?". A logo with "45" and "1971-2016" is in the upper left. The bottom left contains a date range "23-29 MEI 2016," a price "RP 39.500," a website, and a barcode with the numbers "00013" and "9 770126 427302".
